prompt: I have a bunch of hex tile PNGs in Design/hex-crops-v2/ that are 120x104 pixels with a black border around each hex shape. I need to clip them to just the hexagon on a transparent background — remove the white corners and the black border. They're flat-top hexagons. Can you process all of them and save the results?

assertions.text: Output files exist for all 51 source PNGs
All output files have RGBA mode (alpha channel present)
All corner pixels (TL, TR, BL, BR) are fully transparent (alpha=0)
All center pixels are fully opaque (alpha=255)
Transparency ratio is between 35-50% for all files
No pure white (#ffffff) artifacts in edge regions
Edges are anti-aliased (some semi-transparent pixels exist)
